# Nova Ltd. (NVMI): valuation-readiness research, v2
Research cutoff: 18 October 2026. All financial amounts USD millions unless stated. Status: operating scenario candidate for independent audit; exact equity value and current per-share value remain gated.

## Decision-useful conclusion
Nova combines dimensional, materials and chemical metrology with an expanding service base. GAA, advanced DRAM and advanced packaging increase measurement requirements, but exposure remains concentrated in a few customers and Asian manufacturing locations. The funded operating DCF produces $2.02bn / $4.07bn / $6.32bn enterprise values in downcycle/base/upside cases. These are scenario outputs, not price targets or probabilities. The latest formal Q3 revenue guide is $277–287m; results are scheduled for November 5 and were not reported by this cutoff. [Q2 release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891326003892/zk2635873.htm), [IR](https://www.novami.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/nova-investor-presenation-q22026.pdf)

The capital and discount origin is deliberately **31 December 2025**, when full claims disclosures are available. Later operating evidence informs forecasts, and October market inputs determine discount rates. This is a retrospective-information analytical case, neither a contemporaneous December estimate nor an October cash reconstruction. H1 2026 cash flow is included in the full-year operating forecast, not added again to opening cash. Robinhood’s official US page offers NVMI buy/sell; the security is Nasdaq ordinary shares, with a TASE dual listing, rather than an ADR. Public availability does not verify a particular account’s permission. [Broker](https://robinhood.com/us/en/stocks/NVMI/), [20-F](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891326000504/zk2634307.htm)

## Business, economics and current evidence
FY2025 sales were $880.577m, comprising $705.598m products and $174.979m services. China represented 33%, Taiwan 29%, Korea16% and US9%; the two largest customers contributed23% and10%. These are geography/customer views of the same revenue, not additive segments. Nova reports one operating segment. Sentronics, acquired January30,2025 for $60.158m, contributed about6% of annual revenue; reported growth therefore includes acquisition contribution. [20-F, Notes3 and16](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891326000504/zk2634307.htm)

H1 2026 sales of $490.266m were13.1% above H1 2025; GAAP operating income was$147.021m. Q2 sales reached$254.958m, GAAP operating margin29.88% and non-GAAP operating margin33.44%. The spread includes SBC and acquired amortization. H1 CFO was only$80.995m versus$144.269m net income, with receivable growth and deferred-revenue drawdown consuming cash. Physical capex was$6.543m and depreciation$7.184m. Funding requirements cannot be inferred from earnings alone. [Q2 statements](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891326003892/zk2635873.htm)

On the August call, management described packaging near one-quarter of product revenue and product mix roughly73% logic/foundry versus27% memory/other. It discussed broader GAA adoption and US capacity expansion. Packaging overlaps logic/memory and is not a separate additive financial segment. The linked transcript is third-party transcription; only this short paraphrase is included here. Numeric releases control where the transcription conflicts. [Call](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nvmi/transcripts/669145-q2-2026/)

The August investor presentation’s non-GAAP model targets revenue above$1bn, gross margin57–60%, operating margin28–33%, R&D15–17%, SG&A12–14% and tax15%. It is a target rather than guaranteed guidance. The32m share assumption does not measure all current equity claims. [Company presentation, slide13](https://www.novami.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/nova-investor-presenation-q22026.pdf)

Detailed histories also contain taxes, net income, working capital, physical depreciation, acquired amortization, equity, leases, shares and capital diagnostics. Pretax less tax reconciles to net income for every year. Narrow book-capital returns omit acquisition assets and R&D capital and are not economic ROIC. A broader2025 proxy including goodwill/intangibles is$453.5m, after separately treating unpaid capital additions and opening government/tax liabilities. Sales/capital is about1.94x; the forecast uses marginal1.6–2.0x and fades to13–22% terminal ROIC rather than perpetuating high historical book returns.

## Funded operating DCF
All scenarios have ten explicit annual forecasts, end-year discounting, and a continuing-value year. Margins are **after fresh equity compensation**, physical depreciation and expensed R&D. Cash taxes fade16.5% to23%, above management’s15% target, recognizing tax-benefit and geographic-mix risk. No interest income on excess cash is included in operating earnings.

| Case | 2026 sales | 2027 sales | Terminal op. margin | g / ROIC | Operating EV | Terminal share |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| downcycle | 1,042.3 | 1,030.0 | 22.0% | 2.5% / 13% | 2,019.6 | 46.0% |
| base | 1,072.3 | 1,260.0 | 25.0% | 3.0% / 18% | 4,071.2 | 56.7% |
| upside | 1,102.3 | 1,378.0 | 27.5% | 3.5% / 22% | 6,316.3 | 63.6% |

For years1–5, reinvestment is the greater of positive incremental revenue divided by marginal sales/capital, or a cash-funding floor. Base physical capex is3.0% sales, physical depreciation1.5%, incremental operating NWC30% of positive sales growth, and incremental operating cash3%. Down/up NWC is34%/28%; down capex3.2%. Revenue declines receive no assumed working-capital release. Years6–10 fade toward NOPAT×g/ROIC, but the funding floor always binds if larger. Year10 and continuing value reconcile to g/ROIC. This explicitly funds inventory, receivables, operating liquidity and capacity; outsourcing does not make growth free. See the annual model CSV and validation file.

Cash capex27.698 plus closing capital payables1.617 less opening7.248 implies2025 accrual additions22.067 before acquisition/FX. The1.617 opening claim is deducted once and excluded from operating supplier financing. Forecast capex is fully cash funded. Inventory purchase commitments152.965 are reflected in future inventory/cost assumptions, not deducted again as financial debt. [20-F cash-flow supplement and Note13](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891326000504/zk2634307.htm)

### Discount rates and return assumptions
The base initial WACC is10.9775%, fading to9.5923%. Source observations: October16 US10-year5.09%; October1 US default spread0.22% and raw impliedERP4.20%, giving adjusted risk-free4.87% and adjustedERP4.42%; January2026 cash-corrected unlevered semiconductor-equipment beta1.39. Analyst choices are3% target straight-debt weight,23% tax shield,150bp straight-debt spread and mature equity beta1.10. The 0% convertible coupon is not a risk-free financing cost. [Treasury](https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve&field_tdr_date_value=2026&field_tdr_date_value_month=202610), [ERP](https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/home.htm), [Sector beta](https://pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/datafile/Betas.html)

Down/up initial and terminal rates are base+120bp/base−30bp. Terminal growth2.5–3.5% is below the discount rate and paired with explicit13–22% ROIC reinvestment. Operating shocks address concentration/export/conflict risk; the file also tests parallel discount shifts of±150bp, margins±200bp and an extra100bp fresh-grant cost. These are analyst sensitivities, not statistical confidence intervals.

### Equity compensation without double counting
2025 fresh RSUs were113,789 at weighted grant value$296.25, about$33.71m or3.83% of sales, versus2.99% recognized SBC. Fresh economic cost is therefore4.0% initially, fading3.5%, retained inside forecast margins. Existing396,262 RSUs and12,879 options are separate legacy claims. The42.683m unrecognized legacy expense is displayed over four years and identically reversed before economic NOPAT; existing awards are then charged once through units/options value. No further future dilution or assumed buyback benefit is added. Performance payout completeness and option time value remain unresolved. [20-F Note14](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891326000504/zk2634307.htm)

## Coherent dated claims bridge and hard gates
At December31, eligible liquid assets are1633.241, comprising cash214.462, short deposits512.250 and securities906.529. Reserve26.417 for operating cash and fund future increases. Exclude the entire12.508 noncurrent deposits/restricted-cash balance until availability is mapped; .318 is explicitly restricted. No claim is made that these are October balances. [20-F balance sheet and Note2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891326000504/zk2634307.htm)

The2030 convert has principal750 and carrying value731.680, but its quoted December fair value is936.270. Deduct the **full quoted claim once**, with no second principal deduction and no2.34255m convertible-share addition. Nova can settle in cash, shares or both; unlike ONTO there is no asserted cash-principal mandate. The old2025 notes were fully converted; their2.432803m shares are already included in the31.780111m common count. June2026 current-liability classification is a later warning, not permission to splice June cash into this bridge. [Note11](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891326000504/zk2634307.htm), [Indenture](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891325003263/exhibit_4-1.htm)

Capped calls were bought for51.826 plus1.407 issuance costs, already reflected in cash. Strike is about320.16 and cap415.03. The filed form defaults to cash settlement, uses40-day averaging and excludes make-whole/discretionary conversion adjustments; it contains blanks, so aggregate economics come from the issuance and annual disclosures. December fair value is unknown. Crediting historical cost is only an explicit illustration, never a measured asset. No simultaneous asset credit and dilution netting. [Issuance](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891325003263/zk2533763.htm), [Confirmation form](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891325003263/exhibit_10-1.htm)

Other separately deducted claims total51.325: capital payables1.617, conservatively the whole governmental-institutions liability39.148, government grants payable1.116, UTB6.724 after removing the4.036 DTA offset, and unfunded severance2.720. Government/tax balances are excluded from operating NWC. Rent stays in operating costs, so the67.475 operating-lease liability is not separately deducted. Net deferred taxes are not automatically credited at book value. Repatriation, derivatives and residual opening claims remain review gates. [20-F Notes9–15](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891326000504/zk2634307.htm)

The JSON contains illustrations assuming capped-call value51.826, option claim5, residual claims5 and396,262 legacy RSUs, which yield about$83/$147/$217 per share. **These are conditional algebra, not accepted fair values, current targets, or recommended prices.** Exact equity and per-share fields are null. Their fixed quoted convertible claim is market-dependent and not repriced consistently across intrinsic scenarios. A current valuation requires a new unified claims date, award payout/option values, capped-call valuation and residual claims reconciliation.

September’s$200m repurchase program is authorization, not evidence of cash spending or share cancellation. No fictional reduction is applied. [Authorization](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109345/000117891326004385/zk2636060.htm)

## What could change the case
Monitor repeat orders for GAA/materials and packaging tools, service mix, China exposure, receivable collection, inventory turns, Sentronics integration, operating cash conversion and fresh grant economics. Negative scenarios include AI capacity digestion, export restrictions, customer concentration, Israeli conflict, competitive qualification losses, tax-incentive erosion and hedge counterparty/settlement mismatch. The case is unpublished and requires independent review before any Atlas valuation acceptance.
